## Sydney Bathroom Ceiling Leak Notice

A clear, polite message that documents the issue and asks for prompt action.

## Tenant Message Draft

**Subject:** Urgent repair request: bathroom ceiling leak after heavy rain

Dear [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m writing to report a leak in the bathroom ceiling of my apartment in Sydney. The leak appears after heavy rain, and I believe it may be coming from above or from the building structure.

The building is a 1998 concrete high-rise, so I would appreciate this being treated as a maintenance issue that may need prompt inspection. At this stage, the leak is affecting the bathroom ceiling and I want to make sure it is assessed before any further damage occurs.

Could you please arrange an inspection within the next **48 hours**? I would be grateful if you could also let me know the next steps for repair and whether you need any photos or additional details from me.

For record-keeping, I’m noting that the issue was observed after heavy rain and seems to recur in wet weather. Please reply in writing if possible.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,
[Your Name]
[Address / Unit Number]
[Phone Number]
